verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage ships configurable screening setups and agentic workflows, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The evidence never shows version history, change review, or rollback for those configurations or workflows. API endpoint versioning and case audit trails are adjacent features, not versioning of a user's own automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
